CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 518.

CONFIDENTIËEL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
D H 206
2/12/33

SHANGHAI, 20th February 1933.

Sir,

With reference to the letter addressed by H. de Waal,
Kali Besar, n. 6 at Batavia to the Soviet Consul-General at
Shanghai, which was handed to this Consulate General in the
beginning of November last year, I have the honour to inform
you that inquiries made by the Netherlands Indian Authorities
show that Mr. de Waal can not be considered as a person dan-
gerous to public peace and order.

His application for a position in Soviet Russia should be
looked upon as having been made by a person, who, being entirely
without means, and having tried to obtain employment everywhere,
looks forward to an appointment in Russia as a last ressort.

So far nothing to his detriment from a political point of
view has come to the knowledge of the Netherlands Indian Autho-
rities.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
for Consul-General.
Chri. de.

T.P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

B copy Please acknowledge
JW
2/12/33

pages.en:
Copy of letter in English dated September 16, 1932, Batavia addressed
to " the Consul-General of the Union of Russian Republics, Shanghai,
China".

Dear Sir,

I shall be extremely obliged if you would be good enough
to inform me regarding the following matter:
For some time it has been my intention to seek a position
in Russia and the more I read about the Union of Russian Republics
the greater my interest has been in the strong idealism on which the
the new civilisation of your country is based, and the stronger my
objection became to the present-day European-American civilisation.
At the moment I have come to the stage that I seriously want to get
away from this civilisation where money is in the end the only stan-
dard and measure of everything-and where lack of money means a life
which is restricted in every way.

I should therefore be obliged if you would inform me
whether there would be any possibility at all for me to find a posi-
tion in Russia and, if so, in which way I could achieve this aim best.

For your guidance I would emphasize that I have come to
this decision after ripe thought and because as an idealist I have
been thoroughly fascinated by the vitality and vigor of this new
ideal of civilisation, while further I hope to find in Russia some
work to which I can devote myself while being in a country where com-
paratively all live in the same way and where lack of money does not
necessarily mean restriction.

As regards myself I can say that I am 33 years of age
and unmarried. I have 12 years experience in the import-trade, the ex-
port-trade, business managing and administration. I speak English,
French and German fluently and I have a quick brain, energy and imagi-
nation so that I am confident I could be useful for almost any intel-
lectual work, whereas my knowledge of languages would probably be use-
ful for all employments connected with foreign trade or anything else
which has to do with other countries.

It will naturally be essential to speak Russian well
in order to find any employment at all in Russia and I shall of course
start taking lessons at once if you think there would be a good
chance for me to make a living in your country.

Hoping to hear from you and thanking in anticipation
for any news, I remain, Dear Sir,

Yours faithfully
( Signed ) De Waal.

H. de Waal
Kali Besar W 6
Batavia ( Netherlands India )
pages.zh:
1932年9月16日于巴达维亚发出、致“中国上海俄罗斯共和国联盟总领事”的英文信件副本。

尊敬的先生：

若蒙告知以下事项，我将不胜感激：
一段时间以来，我一直有意在俄国谋求职位；我对俄罗斯共和国联盟了解越多，就越对该国新文明所基于的强烈理想主义产生兴趣，同时也越加反对当今的欧美文明。目前，我已下定决心，要 seriously 摆脱这种金钱最终成为一切标准和尺度、且缺乏金钱意味着生活处处受限的文明。

因此，若蒙告知我是否有可能在俄国找到职位，以及若有，通过何种途径能最好地实现这一目标，我将感激不尽。

供阁下参考，我想强调，这一决定是我经过深思熟虑后作出的；作为一名理想主义者，我被这种新文明理想的生命力与活力深深吸引；此外，我希望在俄国找到一份我能投身其中的工作，同时身处一个众人生活方式大致相同、缺钱并不必然意味着受限的国家。

就我个人而言，我今年33岁，未婚。我在进出口贸易、业务管理及行政方面拥有12年的经验。我能流利使用英语、法语和德语，且思维敏捷、精力充沛、富有想象力，因此我有信心能胜任几乎任何智力工作，而我的语言知识可能对从事对外贸易或与其他国家有关联的任何工作都有用处。

当然，要在俄国找到任何工作，精通俄语是至关重要的；如果您认为我在贵国谋生大有希望，我自然会立即开始学习俄语。

期盼您的回音，并预先感谢您的任何消息。

此致
敬礼

（签名） De Waal.

H. de Waal
Kali Besar W 6
巴达维亚（荷属东印度）
